# Keerthana Varanasi

> Software Development Engineer - 1 specializing in high-throughput backend microservices, event-driven streaming with Apache Kafka, and Redis in-memory caching.

## Professional Summary
Keerthana Varanasi is a Software Development Engineer - 1 at Dhan AI with 2+ years of hands-on experience engineering scalable, distributed backends. She specializes in building event-driven microservices, high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs, and sub-50ms caching architectures supporting 350,000+ live enterprise customers.

- **Microservices Built & Maintained**: 8+ production microservices
- **Scale**: 350,000+ live telecom and enterprise customers supported
- **Latency Benchmark**: Sub-50ms response times achieved via Redis caching and optimized queries
- **Education**: B.Tech in Information Technology from Shri Vishnu Engineering College For Women (2020 – 2024)

## Key Production Impact at Dhan AI
- **Scalable Microservices**: Engineered 8+ resilient microservices serving critical telecom and enterprise workflows.
- **Event-Driven Streaming**: Designed and deployed Apache Kafka event pipelines ensuring zero message loss and real-time synchronization.
- **Low-Latency Caching**: Implemented multi-layered Redis caching strategies reducing database query volume and keeping P95 latency under 50ms.
- **Enterprise CRM Integration**: Built custom connectors and webhook listeners for Salesforce CRM and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
